result.question: Why did Uzziah build watch towers?

readings.answer: Because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain.
readings.support: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly says, “Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert,” giving livestock as the reason for building towers; the love of the soil is linked to having farmers and vinedressers, not to building towers.

result.reason: The text ties tower-building to his having much livestock, while his love of the soil explains his farmers and vinedressers, not the towers.
